package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"errors"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
)

var _ repository.StudentPlanningReadinessReader = (*StudentOnboardingRepoPG)(nil)

// ReadPlanningReadiness deliberately uses a repeatable-read, read-only
// transaction. Draft, profile, accepted provenance, and selected path must be
// observed together, but this projection never creates receipts or mutations.
func (repo *StudentOnboardingRepoPG) ReadPlanningReadiness(
	ctx context.Context,
	studentID string,
) (domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSource, error) {
	if repo == nil || repo.Pool == nil {
		return domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSource{}, errors.New("student onboarding repository pool is required")
	}
	tx, err := repo.Pool.BeginTx(ctx, pgx.TxOptions{IsoLevel: pgx.RepeatableRead, AccessMode: pgx.ReadOnly})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSource{}, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback(ctx) }()
	source := domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSource{StudentID: studentID}
	draft, err := getStudentOnboardingDraft(ctx, tx, studentID, false)
	if err == nil {
		source.Draft = &draft
	} else if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		return domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSource{}, err
	}
	profile, err := scanStudentOnboarding(tx.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT `+studentOnboardingColumns+` FROM student_onboarding WHERE student_id=$1`, studentID))
	if err == nil {
		source.Profile = &profile
	} else if !errors.Is(err, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
		return domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSource{}, err
	}
	provenance, err := listPlanningReadinessProvenance(ctx, tx, studentID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSource{}, err
	}
	source.Provenance = provenance
	path, err := getPlanningReadinessSelectedPath(ctx, tx, studentID)
	if err == nil {
		source.ActivePath = &path
	} else if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		return domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSource{}, err
	}
	if err := tx.Commit(ctx); err != nil {
		return domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSource{}, err
	}
	return source, nil
}

func listPlanningReadinessProvenance(ctx context.Context, tx pgx.Tx, studentID string) ([]domain.StudentPlanningReadinessProvenance, error) {
	rows, err := tx.Query(ctx, `SELECT DISTINCT ON (slot_code)
slot_code, code_value, stacks_value, accepted_draft_version, accepted_profile_version, origin
FROM student_onboarding_turn_provenance
WHERE student_id=$1
ORDER BY slot_code, created_at DESC, provenance_id DESC`, studentID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	result := make([]domain.StudentPlanningReadinessProvenance, 0, 9)
	for rows.Next() {
		var item domain.StudentPlanningReadinessProvenance
		var stacks []string
		if err := rows.Scan(&item.SlotCode, &item.CodeValue, &stacks, &item.AcceptedDraftVersion, &item.AcceptedProfileVersion, &item.Origin); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if stacks != nil {
			copied := append([]string{}, stacks...)
			item.StacksValue = &copied
		}
		result = append(result, item)
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return result, nil
}

func getPlanningReadinessSelectedPath(ctx context.Context, tx pgx.Tx, studentID string) (domain.StudentPlanningReadinessActivePath, error) {
	var result domain.StudentPlanningReadinessActivePath
	err := tx.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT p.id, p.version, p.course_id, p.goal_code
FROM student_learning_context c
JOIN student_learning_path p ON p.id=c.selected_learning_path_id AND p.student_id=c.student_id
WHERE c.student_id=$1 AND p.status='ACTIVE'`, studentID).Scan(
		&result.LearningPathID, &result.Version, &result.CourseID, &result.GoalCode,
	)
	if errors.Is(err, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
		return domain.StudentPlanningReadinessActivePath{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	result.Status = "ACTIVE"
	return result, err
}
